newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen signs US$325 mln in deals since bid.
newsitem.headline: Loewen signs US$325 mln in deals since bid.

text.p: Loewen Group Inc said on Monday said it has signed or closed acquisitions totalling US$325 million since rival Service Corp International launched a hostile bid for Loewen earlier this year.

The deals with 51 cemetery and funeral home operators showed "their confidence that the Loewen Group will remain independent by signing or closing transactions to sell properties valued at more than US$325 million to the company," Loewen said in a statement.
Service Corp launched its hostile bid for Vancouver-based Loewen in September and has since sweetened its offer to US$2.9 billion.
"Through strategic acquisitions and investments Loewen Group has solidified its position in 1996 as the preferred acquirer in our industry," said chairman and chief executive officer Ray Loewen.
